dedupe_keys.name: a naturalistic trajectory dataset with dense interaction for autonomous driving

description: A naturalistic trajectory dataset with dense interaction for autonomous driving is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Xiyan Jiang et al. Driving interaction, a critical yet underrepresented element in trajectory datasets, is central to the development and evaluation of autonomous driving systems. This work presents InterHub, a curated dataset of dense multi-agent interaction events, derived from large-scale naturalistic driving recordings. We employ formal methods to describe and extract multi-agent interaction events, exposing the limitations of existing autonomous driving solutions. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, Image, ZIP. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 18673939230 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
